question: Should OpenClaw add bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets now, and what redaction, permission, retention, and command-binding boundary must they follow?
rationale: The request is plausible and aligned with Control UI ergonomics, but it exposes operational logs and command output in a new surface and depends on unresolved dashboard binding/security decisions.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model first, then implement widgets against approved contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Only Data
options.body: Allow a focused widget PR only for existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output data, excluding new command execution or generic stream bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Widgets
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context and ask contributors to focus on external plugins or missing plugin APIs until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle the Wave 1 dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model first, then implement widgets against approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The current log-tail surface and likely security/product boundary for reused log output are tied most directly to `steipete` in merged history.
